versions.changelog:
- Added initial documentation and usage instructions for the Chinese express tracking tool.
- Supports over 50 major Chinese courier companies without needing an API key.
- Details provided for quick queries, manual company selection, and multi-package tracking.
- Includes a quick reference table for courier company codes.
- Describes output format and best practices for common usage scenarios.
- Technical notes on data source (kuaidi100.com) and script dependencies.
